limits: Source is a community export attributed to PC Revelations, not an official raw game package.
BA/DM/SC filenames are preserved; their action meaning has not been individually certified.
Model transforms, skin weights, key times and native FBX bytes are preserved; no retargeted or invented keyframes.
No final sprite, combat integration, victory/defeat/capture mapping, real body dimensions or full canonical fidelity is certified.
47 files vary during playback at time zero or later. em1200_em1201_BA_1 changes only between a negative reference key and time zero; its nonnegative playback is a fixed pose, not another movement.
